cards.back: NIM packages the model, Triton schedules requests, and TensorRT-LLM runs the maths on the GPUs, all on top of CUDA.
A prebuilt container with a model, engines for several GPU types and precisions, and an OpenAI-compatible API. At start-up it detects the GPUs and picks a matching profile.

cards.front: Why an OpenAI-compatible NIM helps agents
cards.back: Swapping a hosted model for a self-hosted one changes a base URL, not code.
NVIDIA's general model server: many framework backends over HTTP and gRPC, with queuing, batching, model instances and Prometheus metrics.
preferred_batch_size and max_queue_delay_microseconds in config.pbtxt; it groups requests that arrive together, for fixed-size models like embedders.
instance_group runs several instances on one GPU, each with its own CUDA stream so work overlaps. It helps small models that can't fill the GPU alone.
Chains models into one server-side pipeline, such as tokenizer, model, detokenizer, with no client round trips. BLS does the same with Python control flow.
Compiled for a specific GPU type, precision, parallelism and max batch and sequence length, so an H100 engine won't run on an L40S.
Work in one stream runs in order; work in different streams can overlap, such as copying the next batch while the current one computes.
Handles GPU-to-GPU communication for tensor parallelism, over NVLink inside a node and InfiniBand or Ethernet between nodes.
Ampere has no FP8 tensor cores, so an FP8 checkpoint saves memory but gives no speed-up. Ada, Hopper and Blackwell run FP8 fast.
Curator deduplicates and filters training data on GPUs. Evaluator runs benchmarks, LLM-as-judge and custom evals against a model.

quiz.q: Bursty, variable-length LLM traffic. What's the NVIDIA answer?
choices: In-flight batching with a paged KV cache in TensorRT-LLM
quiz.why: Output lengths vary too much for request-level batches, so Triton hands batching to TensorRT-LLM.

quiz.q: A small embedding model leaves the GPU mostly idle. What do you add?
quiz.why: Several instances with their own CUDA streams overlap work on one GPU.

quiz.q: You need to deduplicate a fine-tuning dataset. Which tool?
quiz.why: Curator does exact, fuzzy and semantic deduplication plus quality and PII filters.

quiz.q: You deploy an FP8 checkpoint on A100s to cut cost. What happens?
choices: It runs about twice as fast
Memory drops but there's no speed-up
quiz.why: Ampere's lowest tensor-core precision is INT8, so FP8 saves memory only.

quiz.q: A TensorRT-LLM engine built on H100s is copied to L40S servers. Result?
choices: It runs after a NIM restart
It won't run; engines are tied to a GPU architecture
quiz.why: NIM hides this by shipping several engines and choosing one at start-up.

quiz.q: Which NeMo tool keeps an agent on topic and its tool calls safe, written in Colang?
quiz.why: Guardrails provides input, dialog, retrieval, execution and output rails.

quiz.q: Which GPU generation is the first with FP4 tensor cores?
quiz.why: Blackwell (B200, GB200) lists FP4 as its lowest tensor-core precision.
